svg.title: PurrNet: 34% less server bandwidth than FishNet in the state replication tests. State replication · 100 connections · 20 Hz.

cc:Work.dc:title: PurrNet: 34% less server bandwidth than FishNet in the state replication tests. State replication · 100 connections · 20 Hz.
cc:Work.dc:description: Arithmetic mean: MoveY, MoveWander, SyncVars. 100 objects · 10 s per test · on-wire server downstream · 1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes. One benchmark run; no repeat variability measured. Native replication behavior differs. Fusion uses Photon relay. Full methodology at the link below.
